# College of Communication & Information, University of Kentucky

> > The College of Communication & Information at the University of Kentucky offers academic programs in journalism, media, communication, library science, and information technology, emphasizing student achievement, faculty research, and community engagement.

The college houses three major schools: the School of Journalism and Media (JAM), the Department of Communication, and the School of Information Science (SIS). It offers undergraduate and graduate programs including a Master's in Library Science and online ICT degrees, while hosting lecture series on health communication, First Amendment issues, and professional development.

## Key Topics

- School of Journalism and Media (JAM)

- [Lectures and Symposiums](https://ci.uky.edu/isc/about/lectures-and-symposiums): ISC lecture series including Bowling Executive-In-Residence programs
